_comment: Craft action choices. Ported from User#get_craft_choices + the CRAFTING_COST constants (ItemCraftingCost). revealRequirements make this the tech tree: a recipe stays hidden until they have all been met once, then it is unlocked for good. Useful checks: stat (lifetime counters: crafted:<recipe>, opened:<item>, gained:<item>, exposed:<radiation>, done:<action>) and unlocked (recipe:<id> / action:<name>). Costs and unlock thresholds are placeholder tuning.

recipes.label: Quantum Cache
recipes.tooltip: Compress raw matter into a sealed quantum cache.

recipes.label: Carbon Irradiation Enclosure
recipes.tooltip: A light, graphite-lined radiation chamber. Contains radiation up to tier 4 (microwaves). Holds one quantum cache and one source.

recipes.label: Iron Irradiation Enclosure
recipes.tooltip: A heavy steel-plated radiation chamber. Contains any radiation up to tier 7 (gamma). Holds one quantum cache and one source.

recipes.label: Grow Lamp
recipes.tooltip: A broad-spectrum lamp. Visible light drives photosynthesis: caches yield more carbon.

recipes.label: Infrared Emitter
recipes.tooltip: Heats and cures what it shines on: caches get extra rolls.

recipes.label: Microwave Emitter
recipes.tooltip: Shakes ore loose: iron becomes more likely in caches.

recipes.label: X-Ray Tube
recipes.tooltip: Observation: collapses a cache early. Its contents are revealed and fixed, and nothing changes it after that.

recipes.label: Gamma Source
recipes.tooltip: Mutation: caches may collapse into more caches. Needs an iron enclosure.
